claim: Fix the cycle-1 canonical Sakai-convention KNY embedding: the seven simple roots delta_0,...,delta_6 from KNY 2017 sec.8.2.19 eq (8.101) span a rank-7 sublattice L_delta of the rank-9 orthogonal complement K_X^perp = {v in Pic(X) : <v, -K_X> = 0} under the (configuration-independent) Pic intersection form. The Smith Normal Form of the 7x9 integer matrix expressing the delta_i in a Z-basis of K_X^perp has seven nonzero elementary divisors d_1, ..., d_7, whose product equals the index [L_delta^sat : L_delta] of L_delta in its saturation L_delta^sat inside K_X^perp. The verdict resolves to SATURATED_AT_RANK_7 if all d_i = 1, otherwise NOT_SATURATED_WITH_INDEX_<k> with k = prod d_i > 1 and the saturation closure generators are recorded.

primary_inputs.intersection_form: intersection_form_sakai_nongen() (= GRAM_PIC, configuration-independent per KNY 2017 sec.3.3 eq (3.26), validated in cycle 1)

halt_conditions: HALTED_K_PERP_RANK_MISMATCH: computed K_X^perp rank is not exactly 9
HALTED_KNY_NOT_IN_K_PERP: any KNY delta_i is not orthogonal to -K_X (should be impossible after cycle 1 verification, defensive check)
HALTED_SATURATION_AMBIGUOUS: SNF computation returns non-integer or non-deterministic elementary divisors

HALTED_UNEXPECTED_INDEX: the saturation index is > 6 (would be anomalously large for D_6^{(1)} in a rank-9 ambient lattice; bound chosen as the rank of the affine Cartan = 6, anything larger triggers review)
HALTED_SNF_RANK_DEFICIT: SNF returns fewer than 7 nonzero elementary divisors (would indicate the KNY delta_i are NOT Z-linearly independent in Pic, contradicting cycle 1)
out_of_scope: Identification of L_delta^sat as a known root or weight lattice
Picard form restricted to K_perp / Z*K_anti and its E_8 identification (cycle 3 candidate)
